name: view_difficulty_level_shown_is_played
description: The level the hub shows is the level it plays (M8, design 2.6: 'Every match the hub starts plays the level it shows'): at Hard in Undertow the hub lights no level, so a Try (a solo High Water) plays Normal there and its tooltip names none; back in High Water it plays Hard and says so. A leader's level words answer only while the party forms: queued, the server keeps the party's level, so the words stand fixed with the party's lit, and a pick (the click, or Session.set_difficulty) changes neither the party's level nor the profile's, which would otherwise surface later offline or in the next party; out of the queue the words answer again.

steps.assert: Session.mode_id() == 'undertow' and Session.difficulty_id() == 'hard' and node('HubPanel').level_words() == 'Normal (greyed) | Hard (greyed) | Very Hard (greyed)'
steps.msg: in Undertow at Hard the hub lights no level

steps.assert: resource('res://scripts/ui/builders_screen.gd').try_tip() == 'A solo practice match with this Builder, offline' and Session.try_level() == 'normal'

steps.msg: and the Try plays Normal, as the hub showed

steps.assert: resource('res://scripts/ui/builders_screen.gd').try_tip() == 'A solo practice match with this Builder, offline, at Hard' and Session.try_level() == 'hard'
steps.msg: in High Water the hub lights Hard and a Try plays it
the party forming: my words pick

steps.assert: node('HubPanel').level_words() == 'Normal (fixed) | Hard (lit) (fixed) | Very Hard (fixed)' and node('Level_very_hard').disabled
steps.msg: queued, the words stand fixed, the party's lit
a pick changes neither the party's level nor the profile's
out of the queue the words answer again
and pick for the party and the profile
